teaser.title: Get Uber Eats, Rappi and DiDi orders straight into your POS
teaser.description: Connect your delivery platforms and orders flow into Avoqado on their own, right alongside your counter sales: same menu, same reports, same inventory.
teaser.benefit1: Orders land directly in your POS, ready to prepare
teaser.benefit2: One place to see counter sales and delivery together
teaser.benefit3: Your menu stays in sync automatically
teaser.needsAdmin: Contact an administrator to enable delivery.

requestDialog.title: Request delivery activation
requestDialog.description: Tell us which platforms you have or want. Our team will reach out to connect your channels.
requestDialog.channelsLabel: Which platforms do you have or want to activate?
requestDialog.notePlaceholder: E.g. I already have Uber Eats, still need Rappi...
requestDialog.toastSuccess: Request sent. We'll reach out soon.

pending.title: We received your request
pending.description: We're connecting your delivery channels. We'll reach out as soon as they're active.

live.closedByProviderPaused: Closed from the {{proveedor}} portal (notice recorded in Avoqado {{fecha}}). Resuming it here reopens it on {{proveedor}}.
live.closedByProviderActive: {{proveedor}} reported that this store was closed from its portal (notice recorded in Avoqado {{fecha}}). To reopen it, pause and resume the channel here.
live.injectionTooltip: {{aceptados}} of {{recibidos}} orders got through. Below 99% the provider may suspend the integration.

settings.title: Channel hours, pricing and printing
settings.saveErrorFallback: Try again in a few seconds.
settings.hoursHelp: When this channel accepts orders. Outside these hours the marketplace won't send you orders, so you don't have to reject them — and rejections count against you.
settings.hoursEstimated: You haven't set hours yet, so an estimate is being published (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 22:00). Adjust it to your real hours.
settings.markupHelp: Percentage added to your counter price on this channel only. The marketplace takes a commission from every order; without a markup, each delivery sale leaves you less than you think.
settings.errorDayNoRange: {{day}}: it is on but has no hours.
settings.errorCloseBeforeOpen: {{day}}: the closing time must be after the opening time.
settings.errorMarkupRange: The markup must be between 0 and {{max}} percent.
settings.conflicto: Someone changed this channel while you were editing it. Reload and save again.

agotar.title: Mark sold out on {{canal}} based on your inventory
agotar.help: When a product runs out of stock in Avoqado, it's marked sold out on {{canal}} automatically. Turn it off if your inventory isn't up to date, so products you do have don't show as sold out on {{canal}}.

productos.title: Products on {{canal}}
productos.help: Choose which products are published on {{canal}} and, if you want, a different price for this channel. Prices include VAT.
productos.todoElCatalogoHelp: Products you add later are published too.
productos.masDe5000: Your catalog has more than 5,000 products: tick the ones you want on {{canal}}
productos.guia: Without a fixed price it's published at ${{precio}}
productos.rappiRedondea: Rappi publishes it at ${{precio}}: it only accepts whole pesos
productos.errorPrecio: The price must be a number greater than or equal to 0.
productos.errorPrecios: Some product prices aren't valid: they must be a number greater than or equal to 0.
productos.listaVacia: A channel needs at least one product; pause the channel if you don't want to sell there
productos.nuevosHelp: You added them after connecting the channel. They aren't published until you tick them.
productos.soloNuevos: You're only seeing the new products.
productos.yaNoExisten_one: 1 product on the list no longer exists in your catalog
productos.yaNoExisten_other: {{count}} products on the list no longer exist in your catalog
productos.yaNoExistenHelp: Remove them to keep the list tidy.
productos.yaNoExistenCodigos: Codes that no longer belong to any product are removed when you save.

rappi.subtitleEmpty: Connect your Rappi store and its orders flow into Avoqado automatically.
rappi.needsAdmin: Ask an administrator to connect Rappi.
rappi.pendingHint: Waiting for Rappi to confirm (it can take a few minutes).
rappi.ordersInProgress_one: You have 1 Rappi order in progress; finish it before disconnecting.
rappi.ordersInProgress_other: You have {{count}} Rappi orders in progress; finish them before disconnecting.
rappi.errorNotAccepted: Rappi didn't accept the disconnection. Your store is still connected; try again in a few minutes.
rappi.errorUnconfirmed: We couldn't confirm whether Rappi applied the disconnection. In Avoqado your store is still connected and orders Rappi sends are accepted. Try again.
rappi.errorConnectionChanged: The connection changed in the meantime; check its status and try again.
rappi.errorStillConnecting: Rappi is still finishing connecting this store; try again in a minute.
rappi.errorGeneric: Couldn't disconnect the store. Try again.
rappi.confirmDescription: New Rappi orders will stop reaching Avoqado. You can reconnect whenever you want.
rappi.forceDescription: Rappi might keep sending orders that won't show up here. Receive them on your Rappi tablet or the partners portal.
rappi.openLinkFallback: Rappi didn't open? Open it here

impresion.empaqueNo: Do not print a packing ticket
